```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SHARED 48-CITY CONFIGURATION — ALL APPLICATION COLUMN NAMES ARE LOWERCASE
# ============================================================================
csv_path <- "top_cities.csv"

top_cities <- readr::read_csv(
  csv_path, 
  col_types = readr::cols(
    GEOID = readr::col_character(), 
    .default = readr::col_guess()
  )
)

required_city_columns <- c("region", "city", "state", "lat", "long", "GEOID", "population")
stopifnot(all(required_city_columns %in% names(top_cities)))

top_50_cities <- top_cities |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    region = as.character(region),
    city = as.character(city),
    state = as.character(state),
    lat = as.numeric(lat),
    lon = as.numeric(long),
    geoid = as.character(GEOID),
    pop = as.numeric(population)
  )

stopifnot(nrow(top_50_cities) == 48L,
          !anyNA(top_50_cities[, c("city", "state", "lat", "lon")]),
          !anyDuplicated(top_50_cities[, c("city", "state")]))

# Brook's NASA POWER pipeline adapter: exact UPPERCASE schema requested.
cities_config <- top_50_cities |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    REGION = region,
    CITY = city,
    STATE = state,
    LAT = lat,
    LON = lon,
    GEOID = geoid,
    POP = pop
  )

stopifnot(identical(names(cities_config),
                    c("REGION", "CITY", "STATE", "LAT", "LON", "GEOID", "POP")),
          nrow(cities_config) == 48L)

print(top_50_cities, n = 10)
```

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

# 1. NASA POWER API Data Pull (Washington D.C. example point)
url <- "https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=T2M,PRECTOTCORR&community=RE&longitude=-77.0369&latitude=38.9072&start=19900101&end=20251231&format=JSON"

json_text <- paste(readLines(url, warn = FALSE), collapse = "")
parsed <- fromJSON(json_text)

param_list <- parsed$properties$parameter

climate_df <- map(names(param_list), function(param_name) {
  p_data <- param_list[[param_name]]
  tibble(
    date_str = names(p_data),
    value = unlist(p_data)
  ) |> 
    rename(!!param_name := value)
}) |> 
  reduce(full_join, by = "date_str") |> 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_str, format = "%Y%m%d")) |> 
  select(-date_str) |> 
  relocate(date)

NASA.data <- climate_df
head(NASA.data, 5)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(sf)

# 1. Match NOAA stations using sf spatial coordinates from top_50_cities
stations_url <- "https://www1.ncdc.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/ghcnd-stations.txt"
col_widths <- c(11, 9, 9, 7, 31, 4, 4, 5)
col_names <- c("station_id", "lat", "lon", "elevation", "state", "name", "gsn_flag", "wmo_id")

stations_df <- read_fwf(stations_url, col_positions = fwf_widths(col_widths, col_names)) |>
  filter(str_starts(station_id, "US"))

cities_sf <- st_as_sf(top_50_cities, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
stations_sf <- st_as_sf(stations_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

nearest_idx <- st_nearest_feature(cities_sf, stations_sf)

city_stations <- top_50_cities |>
  mutate(
    station_info_id = stations_df$station_id[nearest_idx],
    station_name    = stations_df$name[nearest_idx],
    distance_km     = as.numeric(st_distance(cities_sf, stations_sf[nearest_idx, ], by_element = TRUE)) / 1000
  )

# 2. Download the 2024 NOAA CSV ONCE, then filter locally for our station IDs
target_station_ids <- unique(city_stations$station_info_id)
noaa_s3_url <- "https://noaa-ghcn-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/csv/by_year/2024.csv"

cat("Downloading 2024 NOAA GHCN data (this downloads once and filters instantly)...\n")

all_noaa_raw <- read_csv(
  noaa_s3_url, 
  col_names = c("ID", "DATE", "ELEMENT", "DATA_VALUE", "M_FLAG", "Q_FLAG", "S_FLAG", "OBS_TIME"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |> 
  filter(ID %in% target_station_ids)

# 3. Filter elements, parse dates, and apply the 90% Completeness Rule
expected_days <- 365 

tidy_noaa_base <- all_noaa_raw %>%
  filter(ELEMENT %in% c("TMAX", "TMIN", "PRCP")) %>%
  mutate(
    DATE = as.Date(as.character(DATE), format = "%Y%m%d"),
    DATA_VALUE = as.numeric(DATA_VALUE)
  ) %>%
  select(ID, DATE, ELEMENT, DATA_VALUE)

completeness_metrics <- tidy_noaa_base %>%
  group_by(ID, ELEMENT) %>%
  summarize(
    days_recorded = n_distinct(DATE),
    share_present = days_recorded / expected_days,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(city_stations, by = c("ID" = "station_info_id"))

# 4. Diagnostic Report: Focus on San Jose and Denver
cat("\n=== 90% COMPLETENESS CHECK: SAN JOSE & DENVER ===\n")
target_cities_check <- completeness_metrics %>%
  filter(city %in% c("San Jose", "Denver")) %>%
  select(city, state, ID, ELEMENT, days_recorded, share_present)
print(target_cities_check)

# 5. Carry geoid through to final tidy dataset (mapping lowercase geoid to uppercase GEOID)
final_tidy_noaa <- tidy_noaa_base %>%
  left_join(
    city_stations %>% select(station_info_id, geoid, city, state, region, lat, long),
    by = c("ID" = "station_info_id")
  ) %>%
  select(GEOID = geoid, city, state, region, ID, lat, long, DATE, ELEMENT, DATA_VALUE)

NOAA.data <- final_tidy_noaa
print(head(NOAA.data, 5))
```

```{r}
# 3. US Census Bureau Gazetteer Data Pull
url_gaz <- "[https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2023_Gazetteer/2023_Gaz_place_national.zip](https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2023_Gazetteer/2023_Gaz_place_national.zip)"
temp <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")

download.file(url_gaz, temp, mode = "wb")
files <- unzip(temp, exdir = tempdir())

gaz_data <- readr::read_tsv(
  files[grepl("\\.txt$", files, ignore.case = TRUE)],
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

Census.data <- gaz_data
head(Census.data, 5)
```

```{r}
# Batch fetch NASA POWER climate data across all 48 cities
get_nasa_power_city <- function(city_name, lat, lon, start = "19900101", end = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")) {
  url <- sprintf(
    "[https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=T2M,T2M_MAX,T2M_MIN,PRECTOTCORR,QV2M&community=RE&longitude=%f&latitude=%f&start=%s&end=%s&format=JSON](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=T2M,T2M_MAX,T2M_MIN,PRECTOTCORR,QV2M&community=RE&longitude=%f&latitude=%f&start=%s&end=%s&format=JSON)",
    lon, lat, start, end
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request(url) |> req_perform()
    parsed <- resp_body_json(resp)
    param_list <- parsed$properties$parameter
    
    map(names(param_list), function(param_name) {
      p_data <- param_list[[param_name]]
      tibble(date_str = names(p_data), value = unlist(p_data)) |> 
        rename(!!param_name := value)
    }) |>
      reduce(full_join, by = "date_str") |>
      mutate(
        date = as.Date(date_str, format = "%Y%m%d"),
        city = city_name
      ) |>
      select(-date_str) |>
      relocate(city, date)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error fetching data for", city_name, ":", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

all_cities_nasa <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(city_name = top_50_cities$city,
       lat = top_50_cities$lat,
       lon = top_50_cities$lon),
  get_nasa_power_city
)
if (nrow(all_cities_nasa) == 0L) stop("NASA POWER returned no city data")
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(leaflet)
library(bslib)

# ==============================================================================
# UI DEFINITION
# ==============================================================================
ui <- navbarPage(
  title = "Local Climate Explorer",
  position = "static-top",
  collapsible = TRUE,
  fluid = TRUE,
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"),

  tabPanel(
    "About",
    h2("How has the climate changed where you live?"),
    p("A demonstration app for teachers and students. Explore daily temperatures and precipitation for U.S. cities since 1990, examine statistical trends, and learn about NASA POWER and NOAA weather-station records.")
  ),

  tabPanel(
    "Explore",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        width = 3,
        h4("Choose your Data"),
        selectInput(
          "selected_city", strong("City"),
          choices = sort(unique(all_cities_nasa$city)),
          selected = "New York"
        ),
        selectInput(
          "climate_metric", strong("Variable"),
          choices = c(
            "Mean temperature (°C)" = "T2M",
            "Max temperature (°C)" = "T2M_MAX",
            "Min temperature (°C)" = "T2M_MIN",
            "Precipitation (mm/day)" = "PRECTOTCORR",
            "Specific humidity (g/kg)" = "QV2M"
          ),
          selected = "T2M"
        ),
        dateRangeInput(
          "date_range", strong("Date range"),
          start = "2020-01-01", end = Sys.Date(),
          min = "1990-01-01", max = Sys.Date()
        )
      ),
      mainPanel(
        width = 9,
        h3("Time Series Climate Trends"),
        plotOutput("time_series_plot", height = "400px"),
        hr(),
        h3("U.S. Climate Map"),
        leafletOutput("climate_map", height = "550px"),
        hr(),
        fluidRow(
          column(6, h4("Summary Statistics"), verbatimTextOutput("summary_stats")),
          column(6, h4("Nearest NOAA Station Metadata"), tableOutput("station_meta_table"))
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  navbarMenu(
    "Statistics",
    tabPanel(
      "Trends",
      h3("Linear Trend & Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) Modeling"),
      plotOutput("regression_plot", height = "400px"),
      h4("Regression Model Summary"),
      verbatimTextOutput("model_summary")
    )
  ),

  tabPanel(
    "Data Explorer",
    h3("Filtered Dataset View"),
    DTOutput("raw_data_table")
  )
)

# ==============================================================================
# SERVER LOGIC
# ==============================================================================
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    req(input$selected_city, input$date_range)
    all_cities_nasa |>
      filter(
        city == input$selected_city,
        date >= input$date_range[1],
        date <= input$date_range[2]
      )
  })
  
  selected_station <- reactive({
    req(input$selected_city)
    city_stations |>
      filter(city == input$selected_city)
  })
  
  output$time_series_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- filtered_data()
    req(nrow(df) > 0)
    
    metric_label <- case_when(
      input$climate_metric == "T2M" ~ "Mean Temperature (°C)",
      input$climate_metric == "T2M_MAX" ~ "Max Temperature (°C)",
      input$climate_metric == "T2M_MIN" ~ "Min Temperature (°C)",
      input$climate_metric == "PRECTOTCORR" ~ "Precipitation (mm/day)",
      input$climate_metric == "QV2M" ~ "Specific Humidity (g/kg)",
      TRUE ~ input$climate_metric
    )
    
    ggplot(df, aes(x = date, y = .data[[input$climate_metric]])) +
      geom_line(color = "#2c3e50", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "#e74c3c", se = TRUE, span = 0.2) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      labs(title = paste("Climate Trend for", input$selected_city), x = "Date", y = metric_label)
  })
  
  output$summary_stats <- renderPrint({
    df <- filtered_data()
    req(nrow(df) > 0)
    summary(df[[input$climate_metric]])
  })
  
  output$station_meta_table <- renderTable({
    st <- selected_station()
    req(nrow(st) > 0)
    st |>
      mutate(distance_km = round(distance_km, 2)) |>
      rename(
        City = city,
        State = state,
        Lat = lat,
        Lon = lon,
        "NOAA ID" = station_info_id,
        "Station Name" = station_name,
        "Distance (km)" = distance_km
      )
  })
  
  output$regression_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- filtered_data()
    req(nrow(df) > 0)
    
    ggplot(df, aes(x = date, y = .data[[input$climate_metric]])) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "#7f8c8d", size = 1) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#2980b9", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      labs(title = paste("Linear Trend Analysis:", input$selected_city), x = "Date", y = input$climate_metric)
  })
  
  output$model_summary <- renderPrint({
    df <- filtered_data()
    req(nrow(df) > 0)
    formula_obj <- reformulate("date", response = input$climate_metric)
    model <- lm(formula_obj, data = df)
    summary(model)
  })
  
  output$climate_map <- renderLeaflet({
    metric <- input$climate_metric
    
    map_data <- all_cities_nasa |>
      inner_join(top_50_cities, by = "city") |>
      group_by(city, state, lat, lon) |>
      summarize(
        temp_change = {
          fit <- lm(.data[[metric]] ~ as.numeric(date))
          coef(fit)[2] * 365.25 * 10
        },
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      drop_na(lat, lon, temp_change)
    
    pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "RdBu", domain = map_data$temp_change, reverse = TRUE)
    
    leaflet(map_data) |>
      addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik) |>
      setView(lng = -98.5795, lat = 39.8283, zoom = 4) |>
      addCircleMarkers(
        lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = 8,
        color = ~pal(temp_change), stroke = TRUE, weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
        popup = ~paste0("<strong>City: </strong>", city, ", ", state, "<br>", "<strong>Trend: </strong>", round(temp_change, 3), " units / decade")
      ) |>
      addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~temp_change, title = "Trend<br>(units / decade)", opacity = 1)
  })
  
  output$raw_data_table <- renderDT({
    datatable(filtered_data(), options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE), rownames = FALSE)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
